cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Pick the Prize
cards.instruction: Make them choose which reward, principle, or relationship matters most when not everything can be kept.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Choose the trophy ceremony or our anniversary dinner. They're at the same time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then you're choosing the trophy and postponing us. Say which.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It could be a short ceremony.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you leave before your name is called? That's the choice.
